facts.text: Meadowlands is located in Chartiers Township in central Washington County, about eight miles north of the city of Washington.
The Meadowlands region produces six billion dollars in annual tourism spending and supports nearly one hundred thousand jobs.
Meadowlands helped secure major global events including the Super Bowl forty-eight, WrestleMania, and the twenty twenty-six World Cup.
The Meadowlands Chamber of Commerce established a convention and visitors bureau in two thousand four to showcase destination members.
Advocates in Meadowlands are working to build a new multi-use convention center on the site of the former Arena.
The Meadowlands Convention and Visitors Bureau markets the region's sports, hospitality, entertainment, and cultural assets to attract visitors.
